plantRemoval.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create ONE standalone transparent square Gredice farming-game operation icon. Supplied icon is a materials and style reference only: toy-like chunky bevelled low-poly geometry, broad facets, warm top-left lighting, tactile matte surfaces, bold warm greens and rich terracotta dirt, dark shaded sides. Slightly elevated three-quarter view framed with 7 percent margin. Strong legibility at 48px, compact centered silhouette and only the listed props. Genuine alpha outside the subject, no scenery, floor, drop shadows, lettering, numbers, borders, sparkles or arrows.
Operation: Uklanjanje biljke.
Subject: Show one whole uprooted tomato plant lifted sideways above the vacated soil pocket by a simplified amber gardener's glove at stem base. Expose a distinctive earthy tangled root ball with three thick warm roots and keep one red tomato clearly attached to the uprooted plant. No harvest tray. The cleared hole and large freed root ball convey removing the whole plant.
plantRemoval.export: Center the illustration on a transparent 640 × 640 canvas with 14% padding per edge on the longest axis. Encode as WebP at quality 90.
